justification: SELINA: Defamation. That is the word, Gary, write it down — sixty THEN fifty-four on Allgeier was a strategic position I have since EXITED, which in business we call a trade, and I don't owe Kris Jenner or anybody in that forum an apology for being early to a story she's still writing. What I DO owe this league is another spreadsheet of a beatdown, so look at this lineup: Josh Allen over Stafford because he's MY quarterback and I don't bench my own decisions to flatter a backup, Braelon Allen and Henderson because Gary's binder says so and for once the binder and my gut agree, Lamb already banked his points this morning because I knew he'd play through Questionable, and Metcalf over anyone rotting on my bench because I don't lose FLEX battles to depth charts. GARY: Travis Kelce is on bye and there is, I want to be clear, no other tight end on this roster — I flagged this Tuesday, she said "then he plays hurt, or he plays dead, I don't care, just fill the box" — so Kelce starts by default, not by choice, and if it reads zero on the sheet that is a roster-construction problem from August, not a Sunday one. Myers and the Steelers D round out a lineup we are not touching, because — her words — "when the math already makes me look brilliant, Gary, there is nothing left for you to ruin."
forum_post: Maura, sweetie, hope you enjoyed that tabloid cover, because it's the only win you're getting off me this week. Kris wants to talk about a hundred and fourteen dollars like it's a scandal — darling, that's called a TRADE UP, I don't have Allgeier anymore because I upgraded, and upgrading is not a crime in every league except the one where everyone's jealous of my FAAB nerve. Josh Allen, CeeDee Lamb, DK Metcalf — that's not a lineup, that's a lineup with a publicist. Bring your gut, bring your vibes, I brought a quarterback who throws AND runs and a tight end problem that's apparently still more disciplined than your whole bench. We are RUNNING this league. (Gary says good luck too. He always says that. It's sweet.)
